sqlMap.select: SELECT DECODE(A.BUYER,'KRHOBA0003','01','KRHOBA0004','02','KRHOBA0005','03',NULL) as "plant", A.QUOTATION_NO as "quotationNo", A.QUOTATION_SEQ as "quotationSeq", '' as "buyerItemNo", A.DESCRIPTION as "description", A.SPECIFICATION as "specification", A.UNIT_MEASURE as "unitMeasure", A.MAKER_NAME as "makerName", DELIVERY_LT as "deliveryLt", B.UNIT_PRICE as "unitPrice", B.CATEGORY_NO as "categCode", B.CATEGORY_TEXT as "categName", A.CONFIRM_USER_ID as "confirmUserId" FROM KEPRQDT A, ICOMBYIT B WHERE A.BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'HOBA') AND A.SND_CHK = 'N' AND A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE != 0 AND A.RECV_FLAG = 'CM' AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE 'NO_CODE%' AND A.ATOB_SEND_FLAG = 'Y' AND A.REF_NO IS NULL AND B.BUYER = 'KRHOBAG001' AND B.BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO
sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO IF_FILE_UC ( KEP_SEQ, DOC_TYPE, BUYER, KEY_NO, KEY_SEQ, DATA02, DATA03, DATA04, DATA05, IF_FLAG, IF_DATE, IF_TIME ) VALUES ( SEQ_IF_FILE_UC.NEXTVAL, 'RT', 'HOBA', #quotationNo#, #quotationSeq#, #buyerItemNo#, DECODE(#resultCode#, '0000', 'C', 'E'), #plant#, #message#, 'N', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') )
sqlMap.update: MERGE INTO IF_PODT_UC A USING ( SELECT #legacyPoNo# AS LEGACY_PO_NO, #legacyPoSeq# AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, DECODE(#status#,'99','C','D') AS STATUS, #buyerItemNo# AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, #itemQty# AS ITEM_QTY, #unitPrice# AS UNIT_PRICE, #rdDate# AS RD_DATE FROM DUAL ) B ON (1 = 1 AND A.BUYER = 'HOBA' AND A.SITE = 'KA' AND A.LEGACY_PO_NO = B.LEGACY_PO_NO AND A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ = B.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AND A.STATUS = B.STATUS AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.ITEM_QTY = B.ITEM_QTY AND A.UNIT_PRICE = B.UNIT_PRICE AND A.RD_DATE = B.RD_DATE ) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( KEP_SEQ, SITE, BUYER, PLANT, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ, STATUS, CREATE_DATE, RD_DATE, BUYER_ITEM_NO, UNIT_PRICE, ITEM_QTY, ITEM_AMT, PURCHASER_USER_ID, REQ_USER_ID, REQ_USER_NAME, REQ_USER_DEPT, REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME, REQ_EMAIL_ADD, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, IF_FLAG, LOAD_DATE, LOAD_TIME, HD_REMARK ) VALUES ( SEQ_IF_PODT_UC.NEXTVAL, 'KA', 'HOBA', #plant#, #legacyPoNo#, #legacyPoSeq#, DECODE(#status#,'99','C','D'), #poDate#, #rdDate#, #buyerItemNo#, #unitPrice#, #itemQty#, #itemAmt#, #poUserId#, #prUserId#, #prUserName#, #reqUserDeptCd#, #reqUserDeptNm#, #REQ_USER_EMAIL#, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), 'N', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), #bigo# )

MERGE INTO IF_GRDT_UC A USING ( SELECT #LEGACY_GR_NO# AS LEGACY_GR_NO, #LEGACY_GR_SEQ# AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ, #LEGACY_PO_NO# AS LEGACY_PO_NO, #LEGACY_PO_SEQ# AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, #GR_QTY# AS GR_QTY FROM DUAL ) B ON (1 = 1 AND A.BUYER = 'HOBA' AND A.LEGACY_GR_NO = B.LEGACY_GR_NO AND A.LEGACY_GR_SEQ = B.LEGACY_GR_SEQ AND A.LEGACY_PO_NO = B.LEGACY_PO_NO AND A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ = B.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AND A.GR_QTY = B.GR_QTY ) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( KEP_SEQ, SITE, BUYER, PLANT, LEGACY_GR_NO, LEGACY_GR_SEQ, STATUS, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ, BUYER_ITEM_NO, UNIT_PRICE, GR_QTY, GR_AMT, GR_DATE, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, IF_FLAG, LOAD_DATE, LOAD_TIME ) VALUES ( SEQ_IF_GRDT_UC.NEXTVAL, 'KA', 'HOBA', #plant#, #legacyGrNo#, #legacyGrSeq#, #status#, #legacyPoNo#, #legacyPoSeq#, #buyerItemNo#, #unitPrice#, #grQty#, #grAmt#, #grDate#, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(('20'||SUBSTR(#changeTime#,1,8)), 'yyyy/mm/dd'),'YYYYMMDD'), REPLACE(SUBSTR(#changeTime#,10),':')||'00', 'N', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') )
